hooks.text: A classified military mirror is about to outscan the Hubble telescope.
NASA built a flagship telescope using a surplus spy satellite mirror.
Could a secret surveillance tool find the building blocks of life?

title: The Spy Mirror Hunting for Alien Worlds
description: NASA adapted a donated spy satellite mirror to create the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, which sees 100 times more sky than Hubble.

beats.text: A classified military mirror is about to outscan the Hubble telescope.
beats.visual: artist's concept of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope in deep space, 2020
queries: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope artist concept

beats.text: In 2012, the National Reconnaissance Office surprised NASA by donating two 2.4-meter surveillance mirrors.
beats.visual: artist illustration of a 2.4-meter reconnaissance mirror system, 2012

beats.text: NASA's first chief of astronomy, Nancy Grace Roman, inspired the team to use this hardware.
beats.visual: NASA portrait of astronomer Nancy Grace Roman, 1960s

beats.text: Engineers adapted the reconnaissance optics into a massive flagship observatory for the 2020s.
beats.visual: clean room photo of engineers working on large telescope optics

beats.text: On August 30, 2026, a SpaceX Falcon Heavy carried this former spy tool to a point 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.
beats.visual: SpaceX Falcon Heavy launching from Kennedy Space Center, 2026

beats.text: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope matches Hubble's resolution but captures an area 100 times larger.
beats.visual: side-by-side field of view comparison between Hubble and Roman telescopes
queries: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope vs Hubble field of view

beats.text: It will scan more of the sky in five years than Hubble did in over thirty.
beats.visual: Hubble Ultra Deep Field panoramic galaxy image

beats.text: This allows the observatory to hunt for thousands of exoplanets using a classified military mirror.
beats.visual: astronomical diagram of gravitational microlensing detecting a planet

better_than_last: Optimized the final beat to use a noun-phrase ending that acts as the subject for the loop, reinforcing the scale contradiction revealed in the hook.
